title: Console and Gallery state round trip
naturalLanguageTask: Hide the Fiddle console, open Gallery, navigate to the Electron Fiddles section and verify that fiddle cards expose Open and Run actions, return to the Fiddle without opening a card, restore the console, and verify the original editors and console are visible again. Do not edit or save files.

setup.readyAssertion: Lynxtron Fiddle is the foreground window, no Welcome or other modal dialog is open, its unobstructed default source editors are visible, and the console is open

precondition: The default Hello Lynxtron Fiddle is visible with its editor mosaic and console

steps.prompt: The bottom console panel is hidden while the source editor mosaic remains visible

steps.target: the white folder glyph inside the rightmost rounded icon in the top command bar, at approximately display-local (542, 146), immediately right of the square terminal icon near (515, 146); this is Gallery, so do not click Run, Search, or Terminal

steps.prompt: The Gallery view is visible inside the Fiddle shell and shows showcase categories or cards

steps.target: the Electron Fiddles gallery card or navigation entry

steps.prompt: Gallery has navigated to the Electron Fiddles section rather than remaining on the Gallery landing page
{sectionVisible: boolean, hasOpenAction: boolean, hasRunAction: boolean}, inspect the Electron Fiddles section and report whether its cards and both Open and Run actions are visible

steps.target: the active white folder glyph inside the rightmost rounded icon in the top command bar, at approximately display-local (542, 146), immediately right of the terminal icon near (515, 146); clicking it returns to the source editor mosaic

steps.prompt: The Gallery is closed and the original Hello Lynxtron source editor mosaic is visible again
The bottom console panel is visible again together with the original source editors
